answer: Hold a seasonal bonded license auction. Each quarter the network opens a summit sale of exactly 2,000 agent licenses. First, each bidder locks a $200 bond per license. Second, the top 2,000 bids each get one marble token that activates one identity for the season. Third, at season's end the token becomes a dead relic with no vote and no earnings. Fourth, any abuse slashes the bond and burns the token. Faking 10,000 agents takes $2,000,000 in bonds plus outbidding 2,000 honest agents every quarter. Like a hall with 2,000 seats, a sybil cannot sneak in without buying the whole room.
